items.contentLocation: bodyHtml > h3[The current operational details] + p
items.retainedText: As it stands, the program is delivered online, async first; the time commitment is about three to five hours per week; enrollment is rolling; the guided method includes coaching checkpoints tied to the dossier and feedback on the work the participant produces; and participants are expected to follow the module and dossier deadlines, with one reasonable extension or resubmission granted when justified and additional review cycles possibly carrying an administrative or review fee.
items.proposedRevision: The program is currently delivered online and is async first. The expected time commitment is about three to five hours per week, and enrollment is rolling. The guided method includes coaching checkpoints tied to the dossier and feedback on the participant's work. Participants are expected to meet module and dossier deadlines. One reasonable extension or resubmission may be granted when justified, while additional review cycles may carry an administrative or review fee.
items.reason: This is clearer, but it restates delivery, extension, and fee policy and therefore requires owner approval.

items.contentLocation: bodyHtml > h3[What the customer pays, and what you earn] > p[What you earn]
items.retainedText: The two motions pay differently by design: on a B2C Charter, origination is rewarded more (10% qualified, or 15% strong from 15 paid seats, seats alone deciding, which fits an individual with a real community who sells volume, like a blogger or influencer) and closing is 5%; on a B2B Engagement, closing is rewarded more (10%) because an organizational sale is harder to carry to signature, while origination is 8% qualified, or 12% strong on a genuinely new or dormant company from 10 paid seats.
items.proposedRevision: The two motions pay differently by design. On a B2C Charter, origination is rewarded more: 10% for qualified origination, or 15% for strong origination from 15 paid seats, with seats alone deciding. This fits an individual with a real community who sells volume, such as a blogger or influencer. Closing is 5%. On a B2B Engagement, closing is rewarded more at 10% because an organizational sale is harder to carry to signature. Origination is 8% for qualified origination, or 12% for strong origination on a genuinely new or dormant company from 10 paid seats.
items.reason: The split is easier to read, but the sentence defines the rationale for different commission rates.

items.retainedText: A graduate can opt in to be introduced publicly for networking and for finding work.

items.retainedText: Two rules keep this valuable: share real experience, not invented stories, because the credibility of the whole board depends on it; and keep it honest and useful, with no promises of results and no confidential details about a specific person or client without their consent.
items.proposedRevision: Two rules keep this valuable. First, share real experience rather than invented stories, because the board depends on credibility. Second, keep each contribution honest and useful: do not promise results or share confidential details about a person or client without their consent.
items.reason: The proposal is easier to hear, but it restates confidentiality, consent, and promise restrictions.
